scope: Eastern / modern districts — Thảo Điền, An Phú & District 2 (Thủ Đức City) + District 7 (Phú Mỹ Hưng); the expat/upscale belt: modern Vietnamese & French fine dining, specialty coffee, Japanese/Korean/Thai, wine bars, riverside, patisserie

outlets.name: MICHELIN Guide Vietnam (HCMC) - Selected / Award articles

outlets.name: VietnamNet
